setup.text: The morning light catches the gray ash of the banked coals. Ilsa arranges a bundle of sticks at the forge mouth and steps back.

option_a.text:
The player asks, "How do you get it going?"

Ilsa glances at the forge mouth and speaks. "You clear back first. Always."

option_b.text: The player mimics her movement, clearing the same way on a separate stick. The wood catches with a small crackle, holding a steady glow.

option_c.text: The player picks up a river stone from the floor and holds it near the coals.
